title: MEMIG: Self-evolving Memory Construction for Antibody Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.41245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory has become central to self-evolving LLM agents, which store and retrieve experience from past rollouts to guide future decisions. Existing systems represent this experience as free-form natural language and maintain it by rewriting, which fits tasks whose experience is narratable. However, in scientific discovery and optimization, experience is often a quantity measured by an oracle under a specific context. Rewriting it as text leaves no index for where a record should be, replaces a measurement with a description, and cannot express how interventions interact. To address this, we argue that agent memory for biomolecule optimization should instead be indexable, quantitative, and structured, and we introduce MEMIG. This memory construction framework realizes these three properties. translated_title: MEMIG：用于抗体优化的自进化记忆构建
translated_abstract: 记忆已成为自进化大语言模型智能体的核心，它们通过存储和检索过往推演的经验来指导未来决策。现有系统将这种经验表示为自由格式的自然语言，并通过重写的方式来维护，这适用于经验可以被叙述的任务。然而，在科学发现与优化中，经验往往是在特定情境下由属性预言器测量得到的一个量化数值。将其重写为文本，既没有留下记录应存放位置的索引，也用描述取代了测量本身，且无法表达干预措施之间的相互作用。为解决这一问题，我们主张用于生物分子优化的智能体记忆应当是可索引的、量化的和结构化的，并据此提出了 MEMIG。该记忆构建框架实现了这三个特性。具体而言，MEMIG 通过基于领域的标识符来应对上述每一个洞见，并累积由属性预言器测量的定量效应，从而……
tldr: 提出MEMIG记忆构建框架，使自进化LLM智能体的记忆具备可索引、量化、结构化三大特性，从而更有效地利用属性预言器测量所得经验来优化抗体等生物分子。
en_tdlr: MEMIG proposes a memory construction framework for self-evolving LLM agents that is indexable, quantitative, and structured, enabling effective antibody optimization by accumulating oracle-measured experience.
